problem: Two behaviorally equivalent deep-cancellation return gates make either individual branch mutation survive.
impact: The duplicated guards obscure which cancellation return is contract-bearing.
suggested_fix: Use one authoritative cancellation return path and retain the exact-reason test.
evidence: Deleting either the outcome-cancelled branch or the later signal-aborted return leaves deep-enrich.test.ts green because the other returns the same exact reason.

class_scope.enumeration_method: Bounded independent deletion mutations of both deep cancellation fallback gates.

verification.evidence: bun test src/wiki/deep-enrich.test.ts -t 'external cancellation' -> 1 pass, 0 fail (original); after temporarily removing the post-race input.signal?.aborted fallback gate, the same command still returned 1 pass, 0 fail. The test exercises the outcome === cancelled gate, but does not distinguish whether the two gates can fail independently. The source mutation was restored; git diff --check reported no source changes.
